gui.retrograde.chunk_map.title: Chunk Status
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.singleplayer_on: Chunk map is singleplayer-only for now
gui.retrograde.confirm_regen.detail: This destroys any changes in the chunk once it reloads. Step away from it first — it won't regenerate while you're standing nearby.
gui.retrograde.confirm_regen_touched.det: This chunk has your changes in it: builds, mining, anything you've placed. Regenerating destroys all of that. You can undo it afterward (shift-click), but only the last few regens per chunk are kept. Step away from the chunk first.
gui.retrograde.regen_result.ok: Retrograde: chunk queued — it will regenerate once it unloads
gui.retrograde.regen_result.too_close: Retrograde: move away from that chunk first
gui.retrograde.regen_result.nothing_to_u: Retrograde: nothing to undo for that chunk
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.tooltip.not_loa: Not loaded — get closer to see resources
gui.retrograde.retrogen.title: Retrogen chunk (%s, %s)
gui.retrograde.retrogen.none_available: Retrograde: no loaded mods have a known retrogen integration
gui.retrograde.retrogen.confirm.detail: This runs that mod's own retrogen command for this chunk. Retrograde doesn't control what it does from here on — check that mod's own settings if it refuses.
gui.retrograde.retrogen.dispatch_failed: Retrograde: couldn't run %s's retrogen command — check the log
